jobs.title: Candidatura spontanea apprendistato
jobs.description:
Apprendistato:

Destinatari

Studenti brillanti che hanno terminato le scuole medie e si apprestano ad entrare nel mondo del lavoro. Ottengono il diploma al termine di una formazione duale che comprende una rotazione tra gli uffici orientata a fornire loro le necessarie conoscenze del settore.

Durata

4 anni (informatica)

Programma scolastico apprendistato informatico sviluppo applicazioni / gestione infrastrutture / sviluppo business digitale

Formazione scolastica: profilo esteso con maturità integrata, presso il Centro Professionale Tecnico a Locarno.

Corsi interaziendali: Ameti Bodio.

Requisiti

• Diploma delle scuole medie con tutti i livelli attitudinali e una media superiore al 4.7.

• Spiccata motivazione, passione verso il contatto con le persone, voglia di studiare e dimestichezza con le cifre e i programmi informatici.

jobs.title: Customer Advisor 100% Team Lugano
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled individual to expertly handle, process and/or forward client calls and partner enquiries, in German, French, Italian and English, on various topics related to cards payment, in accordance with our work instructions.

Key responsibilities:

• Answer incoming calls and handling inquiries from customers and business partners in German, French, Italian and English

• Receive and process client complaints and issues related to credit, prepaid and debit cards

• Ensure timely and satisfactory resolution of client concerns to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty

• Ensure all customer interactions and processes comply with internal quality standards and legal regulations

• Proactively find solutions for client complaints and escalating complex cases to the appropriate department

• Identify sales opportunities (selling and upselling) during interactions with the customers

What do we offer?

• Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

• Numerous benefits and incentives

• Well-being, motivational and team-building activities

For the job opening, we are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

• Commercial or tourism background

• Experience in customer service

• Good knowledge of Office package/ PC use

• Good communication skills

• Languages: Italian, German/Swiss German, French and English

• As the first point of contact with customers, the following soft skills are needed: courtesy, empathy, customer orientation and ability to work in team

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

jobs.title: Collaboratore Servizi Logistici - Ufficio Tecnico
jobs.description:
Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Collaboratore/Collaboratrice Servizi Logistici – Ufficio Tecnico per rafforzare il nostro team. In questo ruolo sarai responsabile del coordinamento e della pianificazione delle attività di manutenzione e riparazione degli edifici e degli impianti tecnici, garantendo operazioni efficienti e un servizio di alta qualità per i nostri clienti interni.

• Organizzazione e pianificazione dei lavori di manutenzione e riparazione degli edifici e degli impianti tecnici

• Gestione delle richieste di intervento e comunicazione con i clienti interni

• Gestione dei processi di acquisto materiale e ordini di lavoro

• Attività di manutenzione, riparazione e altre attività in ambito logistica incluso servizio di picchetto

• Gestione e coordinamento del team di manutenzione

• Conoscenza della tecnica degli edifici (impianti elettrici, riscaldamento, impianti frigoriferi, impianti sanitari, ventilazione, reti ICT)

• Esperienza (10 anni) nella gestione, manutenzione e riparazione di edifici e impianti tecnici, incluso il servizio di picchetto

• Conoscenza di applicativi per la gestione di ticket e asset (EAM, SAP o simili)

• Buone conoscenze di sistemi di gestione edifici (Siemens, Honeywell o simili)

• Ottima conoscenza degli applicativi Office e best practice nell’utilizzo delle tecnologie (PC, App, ecc.)

• Esperienza nella conduzione di un team e nella gestione di piccoli progetti

• Orientamento verso il cliente (interno) e forte spirito per il lavoro di squadra

• Residente in Ticino

• Diploma AFC in ambito tecnico (edilizia e/o impianti) con preferenza per l’ambito elettrico, elettrotecnico o elettromeccanico. Eventuali formazioni superiori in ambito tecnico costituiscono titolo preferenziale

• Italiano (lingua madre) e buona conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale (preferibilmente tedesco). Buone conoscenze dell’inglese

jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and customer-oriented professional to join our team in a dynamic and growing environment. The ideal candidate is eager to develop their skills in client relationship management and credit recovery, combining strong communication abilities with empathy and a solution-driven approach. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, negotiate sustainable payment solutions, and contribute to maintaining positive and professional relationships even in sensitive situations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Negotiation of repayment plans and monitoring of agreed arrangements

• Management and updating of cases in internal systems

• Collaboration with the team to monitor open positions

• Maintaining a professional and empathetic approach even in sensitive situations

• Commercial training (commercial apprenticeship or equivalent qualification)

• Native German and good knowledge of English

• Excellent communication skills and strong customer listening abilities

• Aptitude for managing customer relationships over the phone

• Empathy, mediation skills, and solution-oriented mindset

• Attention to detail and organizational skills

• Team spirit and reliability

Ideal profile

• Young, motivated person eager to grow professionally

• Ability to remain calm and professional even in difficult conversations

• Team-oriented attitude and collaborative mindset

jobs.title: Risk Manager - Asset Liability Management (ALM) and Liquidity Risk

titleByLocale.it: Risk Manager - Asset Liability Management (ALM) and Liquidity Risk
titleByLocale.en: Risk Manager - Asset Liability Management (ALM) and Liquidity Risk
titleByLocale.de: Risk Manager - Asset Liability Management (ALM) and Liquidity Risk
titleByLocale.fr: Risk Manager - Asset Liability Management (ALM) and Liquidity Risk

jobs.description:
The selected candidate will be responsible for managing risks related to Asset Liability Management (ALM) and liquidity risk, ensuring that the company maintains a solid financial position and can navigate market challenges effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct in-depth analysis of risks related to ALM and liquidity risk, identifying potential vulnerabilities and developing mitigation strategies

• Monitor the company's daily liquidity position, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements in alignment with Basel framework and FINMA ordinance

• Collaborate with treasury and finance departments to optimize liquidity management practices, including cash flow forecasting, liquidity buffer management and funding strategies/ contingency plan

• Assess and manage the company's exposure to interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), developing strategies to mitigate adverse impacts on earnings and capital

• Conduct liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of adverse market conditions on the company’s liquidity position

• Prepare detailed and accurate reports on liquidity risk and ALM for senior management, Committee, Regulators, providing clear analysis and recommendations

• Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic environment setting priorities and meet tiny deadlines

• Technical Skills: Advanced knowledge of ALM and liquidity risk, interest rate risk management tools and methodologies, including scenario analysis and stress testing

• Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret and synthesize large volumes of complex data using programming knowledge (Phyton, R, SQL)

• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders

• Experience: At least 3 years of experience in risk management, with a particular focus on ALM/ liquidity risk or treasury department

• Languages: Italian / English native proficiency / French / German is a plus

• Professional certification in risk management (e.g., FRM, PRM) is a plus

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled individual to expertly handle, process and/or forward client calls and partner enquiries, in German, French, Italian and English, on various topics related to cards payment, in accordance with our work instructions.

Key responsibilities:

• Answer incoming calls and handling inquiries from customers and business partners in German, French, Italian and English

• Receive and process client complaints and issues related to credit, prepaid and debit cards

• Ensure timely and satisfactory resolution of client concerns to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty

• Ensure all customer interactions and processes comply with internal quality standards and legal regulations

• Proactively find solutions for client complaints and escalating complex cases to the appropriate department

• Identify sales opportunities (selling and upselling) during interactions with the customers

What do we offer?

• Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

• Numerous benefits and incentives

• Well-being, motivational and team-building activities

For the job opening, we are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

• Commercial or tourism background

• Experience in customer service

• Good knowledge of Office package/ PC use

• Good communication skills

• Languages: Italian, German/Swiss German, French and English

• As the first point of contact with customers, the following soft skills are needed: courtesy, empathy, customer orientation and ability to work in team

jobs.title: IT Auditor
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Head of IT Audit, you will be a key technical expert within the internal audit team. You will be operating in a bank where technology represents a key pillar of the business strategy, with a strong focus on the in-house development of proprietary banking solutions. Your primary mission is to conduct in-depth, risk-based audits across our modern and complex technology landscapes and evaluate IT risks, security controls, and regulatory compliance (FINMA). A central part of your role will be to actively pioneer the future of our audit function by developing and integrating advanced methodologies that leverage data analytics and agentic AI. For this role, we are seeking a hands-on IT Auditor with a strong background in the financial industry and a passion for technology and innovation. Swiss Domicile is mandatory.

•       Execute and Lead IT Audit Engagements: Take an active role in planning, executing, and reporting on risk-based audits covering information technology, infrastructure, data privacy, and information security.

•       Audit Modern Technology Landscapes: Perform in-depth assessments of IT processes, risks, and controls within a cutting-edge environment (AI, cloud, CI/CD pipelines), critically evaluating the design and effectiveness of the internal control system.

•       Shape Audit Strategy: Contribute your IT and security expertise to the risk-based audit planning process, helping to define key areas of focus and strategic priorities.

•       Enhance Audit Methodologies: Drive the modernization of our audit approaches by developing and integrating advanced techniques using data analytics and leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance audit effectiveness, increase assurance, and automate testing.

•       Collaborate on Joint Audits: Lead or assist in integrated audits with the business audit team and manage co-sourced audit engagements with external partners.

•       Support Ad-Hoc Projects: Work independently on ad-hoc assignments and special projects as required by management.

• Education & Certifications: A Bachelor's or master's degree in ICT or equivalent. A professional certification such as CISA, CISM, or CISSP is highly desirable, as is a commitment to obtaining one.

•       Core Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in a technical capacity (e.g., IT Audit, IT Security, IT Risk Management, or IT Compliance) within the Swiss financial industry.

•       Frameworks & Regulations: Strong knowledge of IT audit methodologies and frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST) and a solid understanding of the Swiss regulatory landscape, or the willingness to rapidly develop this knowledge.

•       Data & AI: Relevant experience with data analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, Power BI), combined with the ability to develop and apply AI-driven solutions in an audit context, or a strong willingness to develop this capability.

•       Language Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Italian and English are required. German language skills are a plus.

•       Key Competencies: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, effective team collaboration, a capacity for rapid learning, and high adaptability to change.

•       Travel: Availability for travel approximately up to 10% within Switzerland and also abroad.

•       Mandatory Requirement: Domicile in Switzerland is required.

jobs.title: Legal Collection case Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Legal Collections Specialist to join our team. You will be responsible for managing legal debt recovery

activities and supporting collection strategies within the framework of the Swiss Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy Act (SchKG) and applicable

financial products and consumer finance regulations.

This role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external legal partners, and debtors to maximize recovery outcomes while maintaining a professional and customer-focused approach

What We Offer

• Permanent position in a dynamic and international work environment.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Workplace located in Wallisellen (Zurich), with the possibility of partial remote work (home office).

• Comprehensive onboarding and training program during the first three months at our Lugano office.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of delinquent accounts and initiate, monitor, and follow up on legal debt recovery procedures.

• Prepare, review, and process legal documentation, maintain accurate case records, and monitor ongoing legal proceedings to ensure timely follow-up.

• Liaise with debtors, legal representatives, debt collection agencies, courts, and public authorities, and negotiate payment arrangements and settlement agreements where appropriate.

• Evaluate collection cases, recommend appropriate legal actions, and support the achievement of recovery targets.

• Collaborate with internal departments, including Customer Service, and contribute to the continuous improvement of collection processes and recovery strategies.

• At least 3 years of solid experience in debt collection management within the Swiss enforcement and judicial system (legal collection) is required.

• A strong understanding of Swiss debt enforcement and insolvency procedures, together with familiarity with financial products and consumer finance regulations, would be an advantage.

• Fluent French (C1 level, written and spoken) and good Italian skills (B2 level, written and spoken). Knowledge of German is considered an advantage.

• Strong goal-oriented mindset, organizational abilities, and problem-solving skills.

• The ability to work independently is essential, while also maintaining a strong team spirit and excellent communication with colleagues at the head office while working from a remote branch office.

• High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and case management systems.

• Commercial diploma or equivalent qualification (e.g., a degree in Swiss law, political science, or a related field).

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled individual to expertly handle, process and/or forward client calls and partner enquiries, in German, French, Italian and English, on various topics related to cards payment, in accordance with our work instructions.

Key responsibilities:

• Answer incoming calls and handling inquiries from customers and business partners in German, French, Italian and English

• Receive and process client complaints and issues related to credit, prepaid and debit cards

• Ensure timely and satisfactory resolution of client concerns to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty

• Ensure all customer interactions and processes comply with internal quality standards and legal regulations

• Proactively find solutions for client complaints and escalating complex cases to the appropriate department

• Identify sales opportunities (selling and upselling) during interactions with the customers

What do we offer?

• Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

• Numerous benefits and incentives

• Well-being, motivational and team-building activities

For the job opening, we are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

• Commercial or tourism background

• Experience in customer service

• Good knowledge of Office package/ PC use

• Good communication skills

• Languages: Italian, German/Swiss German, French and English

• As the first point of contact with customers, the following soft skills are needed: courtesy, empathy, customer orientation and ability to work in team

jobs.title: Customer Analytics Officer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join our team within a dynamic banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Work closely together with marketing and digital transformation specialists to understand their needs in terms of data to operate and steer their marketing strategies.

• Develop customer behavioral profiling based on demographic, product usage and and multi-channel touchpoints data (from digital to call center).

• Utilize machine learning, statistical modeling and feature engineering techniques to develop powerful response predictive models that anticipate customer responses and behaviors.

• Develop robust scheduled data feeding procedures by extracting data from multiple data sources, perform data preparation and apply ML models.

• Develop Business Intelligence dashboards to track customer portfolio KPIs, digital adoption and marketing initiatives performance

• Become the data steward of reference for customers and touchpoint data. Collaborate with Information Management specialists to ensure data integrity and effective data modeling.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

• Very strong background in data analysis, including multivariate statistical methods and forecasting models.

• 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, in the financial Industry is an advantage.

• Excellent skills in working with relational databases; proven advanced SQL knowledge, with BigQuery is an advantage.

• Excellent knowledge of the programming language Python and the related libraries for scientific computing (in particular pandas, numpy and scikit-learn)

• Advanced knowledge of MS Excel

• Knowledge of a modern BI tool like MS Power BI is an advantage.

• Knowledge of the IBM SPSS data analytics software or similar is an advantage.

• Analytical and solution oriented mindset, excellent problem solving abilities

• Self-motivated and proactive personality

• Outstanding communication skills. Fluency in Italian, English and German required.

• Workplace: Lugano/Zurich

jobs.description:
Key responsibilities:

• Act as a security partner for projects and initiatives, ensuring secure-by-design principles

• Perform risk and control assessments across IT and business processes

• Define and validate security requirements for new systems and changes

• Ensure the implementation and effectiveness of security controls (aligned with FINMA, LPD, ISO 27001 / NIST)

• Manage security exceptions and risk acceptances, ensuring proper governance and traceability

• Contribute to security policies, standards, and second line of defense activities

• Support internal and external audits on security and IT risk topics

What do we offer?

• Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

• Numerous benefits and incentives

• Well-being, motivational and team-building activities

• 3–7+ years in Information Security, IT Risk, or Security Governance

• Experience in project security / security assurance / control frameworks

• Strong understanding of risk management and regulatory expectations (FINMA is a plus)

• Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA are an advantage

• Fluent English and Italian (mandatory). German and/or French is a plus

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

We are looking for a Senior Security GRC professional to join our team and strengthen our cybersecurity, risk, and compliance capabilities in a regulated banking environment.

In this role, you will act as a liaison between IT, business leadership, and regulators, ensuring that security and compliance are effectively embedded across the organization.

Key responsibilities:

• Execute cyber & ICT risk assessments, BIA, and risk treatment plans

• Ensure compliance with FINMA circulars, ISO 27001, LPD, PCI DSS and relevant regulations

• Oversee third-party / vendor risk management

• Maintain and enhance the ISMS, policies, and controls framework

• Oversee IT & security audits (internal/external)

• Develop GRC dashboards, KPIs and reporting for CISO

What do we offer?

• Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

• Numerous benefits and incentives

• Well-being, motivational and team-building activities

• 5+ years in Cybersecurity, IT Risk, Audit, or GRC (banking/fintech preferred)

• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS

• Experience with regulatory environments (FINMA highly valued)

• Professional certifications (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CDPSE) are a plus

• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights

• Fluent English and Italian (mandatory). German (strong advantage)

jobs.title: Employee Consumer Dispute Management
jobs.description:
We are looking for a customer-focused and detail-oriented Customer Disputes & Fraud Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in protecting our customers and ensuring the efficient handling of credit card disputes and fraud cases in a dynamic financial services environment.

• Receiving and handling customer complaints and credit card fraud cases, including initial assessment and prioritization.

• Processing dispute claims and fraud-related cases.

• Performing chargebacks in accordance with the regulations of the card schemes (VISA, Mastercard, Diners Club) and internal company policies.

• Advising cardholders on disputes, card misuse, and preventive security measures.

• Providing customer support by phone and in writing in German, French, English, and Italian.

• Carrying out various administrative tasks.

• Experience in credit cards, chargebacks, fraud management, or customer service is an advantage.

• Excellent language skills in German, French, English, and Italian (both spoken and written).

• Analytical, structured, accurate, and reliable working style.

• Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and enjoy working in a dynamic environment.

What do we offer?

Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

Numerous benefits and incentives

Well-being, motivational and team-building activities
